stem:
Diya must make an exact copy of $\angle PQR$ at a new vertex $S$ on a fresh ray.

Which construction copies the angle?

options.text: Name the new vertex $S$ as the copied angle, and transfer no lengths from $\angle PQR$.
Draw any arc at $S$ only, and leave the chord from $\angle PQR$ unmatched.
From $Q$ and from $S$ draw arcs of the same radius; transfer the chord between the arc hits on $\angle PQR$ onto the new arc, and join to form the equal angle at $S$.
The finished equal angle at $S$ is what produces the matching arc radius and chord.

teacher.key_rationale: Copying an angle transfers the same arc radius and the same chord between arc hits onto the new ray. Naming S as the angle, omitting the chord match, or reversing finish-creates-transfer all miss that transfer.
